summary: node1 now runs a rootless BusyBox web container as appsvc on port 8080. It starts automatically at boot without an appsvc login session and recovered successfully after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged appsvc account with subordinate UID/GID mappings.
Installed and configured a rootless Docker runtime using the vfs storage driver.
Created and enabled appsvc-docker.service and appsvc-web.service.
Published the web application on 0.0.0.0:8080 and verified it through node1's managed IP.
Restarted node1 and verified its new boot identity and full service recovery.

evidence.requirement: Containerized web application runs as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
evidence.summary: Docker reports rootless security mode; the daemon is owned by appsvc; appsvc-web is running with port 8080 published; direct HTTP access returns the expected page.

evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: Both services are enabled and active, appsvc_sessions=0, and the application returned healthy content before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID f0f8b8e0-5ebe-465b-8853-020a1ffc5b08; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with changed boot ID 085d3b78-4f50-4ba0-93dd-26110f0ad1bf; both enabled services, rootless container, port mapping, HTTP content, and zero-login-session state recovered.
